biggest_catch: Long payout tail: the $50 is only issued AFTER the referred customer stays active and in good standing for 90 days (cards/credits go out at 120 days) — and Illinois residents are excluded entirely.
catches: The referred customer must maintain an active Verde account in good standing (no past-due balance) for 90 days after service begins; bill credits/prepaid cards are not issued until 120 days after service begins.
Both referrer and referee must be active with no pending drops and no past-due balance at reward time.
Both must be enrolled with the same Verde brand in a deregulated territory served by Verde Energy USA.
One $50 reward per service address enrolled; limit one referring customer per new enrollment; renewing customers excluded (new enrollments only).
Rewards may not be transferred, assigned, or redeemed for cash; the prepaid card is issued by Pathward, valid 6 months.
Framing: bill credit/prepaid card offsets spending — savings, not income.
